import pathlib
OLD = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\github-operations\temp\old-master.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
NEW = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\github-operations\temp\new-master.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
for f in ("AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"):
    p = pathlib.Path(f); s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    if not s.startswith(OLD): raise SystemExit(f"{f}: master prefix mismatch")
    p.write_text(NEW + s[len(OLD):], encoding="utf-8", newline="")
a = pathlib.Path("AGENTS.md").read_bytes(); c = pathlib.Path("CLAUDE.md").read_bytes()
if a != c: raise SystemExit("AGENTS.md != CLAUDE.md after edit")
print("edited ok")
